query: UPDATE sandbox_instances SET phase='destroying',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE conversation_id=$1 AND ($2::timestamptz IS NULL OR (last_action_at=$2 AND $3=COALESCE((SELECT MAX(seq) FROM events WHERE conversation_id=$1),0) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM idempotency WHERE conversation_id=$1 AND execution_status='queued'))) RETURNING conversation_id
